description: Move complimentary-access domain control entirely server-side: remove the isComplimentaryAccessEmail shortcut from src/hooks/useBillingStatus.ts and src/pages/signup/welcome.tsx (both bypass the API and use a Vite build-time env var that can be overridden), add an audit log in the backend getBillingStatus complimentary branch, remove VITE_COMPLIMENTARY_EMAIL_DOMAINS comment lines from .env.example, and document COMPLIMENTARY_EMAIL_DOMAINS (no VITE_ prefix) in v2-backend/.env.example. Independent of FEAT-001/002/003 in terms of files touched — can be applied in any order but should come last to avoid confusion with the DB-unavailable fixes in FEAT-001.
steps: Step 1 — Add audit log to backend complimentary-access branch in v2-backend/src/services/billing.service.ts: in getBillingStatus, the existing 'if (isComplimentaryAccessEmail(email))' block at line ~28 currently returns complimentaryBillingPayload without logging. Add this.logger.log(`[BillingService] Complimentary access granted to ${email}`) before the return statement. This is the only change to billing.service.ts in this FEAT.

Step 2 — Remove isComplimentaryAccessEmail frontend bypass from src/hooks/useBillingStatus.ts: delete the block 'if (isComplimentaryAccessEmail(user?.email)) { setData(complimentaryBillingStatus(user?.roles?.[0])); setError(null); setLoading(false); return; }' (currently around lines 44-49 in the refresh callback). After removal, check whether complimentaryBillingStatus and isComplimentaryAccessEmail imports from '../utils/complimentaryAccess' are still used by any remaining code in the file. If both are now unused, remove their import lines.

Step 3 — Remove isComplimentaryAccessEmail early exit from src/pages/signup/welcome.tsx: in the useEffect, find the line 'if (isComplimentaryAccessEmail(user?.email)) return;' (currently ~line 61). Delete this line — the existing check 'if (status === "trialing" || status === "active") return;' a few lines below already covers the complimentary case once the API returns the correct status. Remove the import of isComplimentaryAccessEmail from welcome.tsx if it becomes unused.

Step 4 — Remove VITE_COMPLIMENTARY_EMAIL_DOMAINS from .env.example: open /home/angeli/Desktop/luxcity/proptii-r1.1a/.env.example and delete lines 121-122 (the two comment lines: '# VITE_COMPLIMENTARY_EMAIL_DOMAINS=theluxcity.co.uk' and '# Backend equivalent: COMPLIMENTARY_EMAIL_DOMAINS=theluxcity.co.uk'). Also check .env, .env.development, .env.local, .env.prod, .env.production — the audit found no actual VITE_COMPLIMENTARY_EMAIL_DOMAINS values in these files (only in .env.example as comments), so only .env.example needs editing.

Step 5 — Document COMPLIMENTARY_EMAIL_DOMAINS in v2-backend/.env.example: add a new section after the ADMIN_EMAIL entry: '# ─── Complimentary Access ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────' followed by a descriptive comment and 'COMPLIMENTARY_EMAIL_DOMAINS=theluxcity.co.uk'. The variable is already read by v2-backend/src/utils/complimentary-access.ts — this step just documents it properly.
acceptance_criteria: src/hooks/useBillingStatus.ts no longer has an isComplimentaryAccessEmail shortcut that bypasses the API
src/pages/signup/welcome.tsx no longer has an isComplimentaryAccessEmail early exit
Backend getBillingStatus logs complimentary access grants
